summary: protocol_harness.rb gets the loader rather than the deletion: one command runs it, drives it with the independent WebSocket client, and asserts the exchange

coordination.notes: The increment offered two branches, loader or deletion, and the facts fit neither as written: the harness is not dead. It was introduced by 04ebd18e, is documented in lich-scripts/test/README.md and docs/TESTING.md as a manual two-shell procedure, its counterpart client tools/ws-client.mjs exists and is tracked, and both were run today against the current bridge and worked end to end. Deleting a working verification tool because nothing automated calls it is the wrong half of the choice, so this is the loader. tools/ws-client.mjs was extended in place rather than copied into a test-shaped sibling: it now exports runProtocolClient and keeps its command-line behaviour. It was also a check that could not fail - it called process.exit(0) on close whatever frames it had received, so a bridge that accepted the socket and said nothing passed exactly like a working one.
